{{Quote|They have insertion skills. Combat skills. We don't know yet if those X-wings were actually StealthXs or regular X-wings dressed up to look that way. Their activities in Glitterby Base were&hellip;weirdly undisciplined. I think we’re looking at Jedi or Sith.|Unidentified Pop-Dog field coordinator, on Wraith Squadron|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and field coordinator in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] on a [[Hunt for Stavin Thaal|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], the leader and founder of the Pop-Dogs. After escaping from [[Glitterby Base]], which was under Pop-Dog control, the Wraiths took refuge in the [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]], where they were [[Siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological station|besieged]] by the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" />

The field coordinator was stationed in a command center with Thaal and other Pop-Dogs officers, where they monitored the siege through multiple views from the troopers' helmet [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]]. At Thaal's instruction, she reordered the views by their proximity to the meteorological station and displayed the corresponding positions and holocam feeds of nearby personnel. After a booby trap planted by the Wraiths destroyed the station, causing the holocam views to go dark, the field coordinator gave Thaal her assessment of the attackers.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pop-Dog field coordinator was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
